findings.body: The diff adds `MemoryPendingStore`, `PENDING_TTL_SECS`, `PendingAuthorization`, and `PendingAuthorizationStore` to the `oauth` import list. If any of these identifiers are not exported by `crates/tinymcp/src/registry/oauth.rs`, compilation will fail, preventing the crate from building. Confirm that these symbols exist (or adjust the import) before merging.
findings.title: Verify newly imported OAuth symbols exist
